android.desc: Transform your note-taking experience with Squid! For over 12 years, Squid has been a trusted app with over 12 million installs, helping users replace paper, save money, and reduce waste. Write just like you would on paper on your Android tablet, phone, or Chromebook! ✨ Key Features: • ✍️ Natural Writing: Seamlessly write with a pen and erase with your finger on active pen enabled devices like Samsung devices with S Pen. Use your finger or capacitive stylus on other devices. • ⚡ Low Latency Ink: Enjoy a seamless and responsive writing experience with support for low latency ink¹. • 🔒 Private: Notes are stored on your device and are completely private. No account or sign-in required. Backup your notes to your desired location. • 📝 PDF Markup: Easily annotate PDFs, fill out forms, edit/grade papers, and sign documents. • 🧰 Versatile Tools: Use any color pen or highlighter, import images, draw shapes, and add typed text. • 📁 Organize: Select, copy/paste, and move content between pages and notes. Place notes in folders to stay organized. • 📊 Presentations: Turn your device into a virtual whiteboard and cast your notes to a TV/projector. • 📤 Export: Export notes as PDFs, images, or Squid Note format and share or store in the cloud. • 💰 Save: Reduce stationery costs and replace paper notebooks with Squid for eco-friendly note-taking! 🏆 Awards/Recognition: • 🌟 Featured App and Editors' Choice in Google Play • 📈 Category Honorable Mention for Productivity in the Samsung Galaxy Note S Pen App Challenge • 🎉 Popular Choice Award in the Dual Screen App Challenge 👑 Squid Premium: • Premium paper backgrounds: math, engineering, music, sports, planning, & more • Import and markup PDFs • Additional tools: highlighter, true eraser, shapes, text • Backup/restore and bulk export notes as PDFs to Google Drive, Dropbox, or Box 🛠️ Base Features: • Vector graphics engine keeps your notes beautiful at any zoom level and on any device • Various paper backgrounds (blank, ruled, graph) and sizes (infinite, letter, A4) • Erase entire letters or words quickly with the stroke eraser • Undo/redo, select, move, and resize • Change color and weight of selected items • Cut, copy, and paste items between notes • Two-finger scroll, pinch-to-zoom, and doub

quotes.text:
I use an Android app called Squid[1] for drawing and taking notes on my Pixelbook with the pencil. It is technically an android app, but it's easy to forget that because it just runs so perfectly and it's optimized for tablets and large screens. Same experience with apps like Todoist and a few mobile games I play. It really is a wonderful and seamless experience.

[1] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.steadfastinnovation.android.projectpapyrus&hl=en_US

quotes.text:
I use Squid on Android. I learned to adjust the options to suit me well.  I use my stylus for writing or drawing and use my fingers to lasso objects to move them or resize them.  My stylus has an eraser function when I use the back end of the stylus.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.steadfastinnovation.android.projectpapyrus&hl=en
